III. Where Special Skilled Trades Representatives are selected pursuant to Paragraph I-B, they shall work at their regular jobs except when carrying out the representation duties and functions as provided herein. Even though such Special Skilled Trades Representatives are not committeepersons, they will nevertheless be governed by the provisions of Paragraphs (17), (20), and (22) of the National Agreement.

IV. The provisions of Paragraph (21) of the National Agreement will not be applicable to the Special Skilled Trades Representative.
